summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing: Detailed Explanation of Physical Properties In Marvelous Designer, you can express various fabrics through texture and physical properties. I believe you can do the texture processing in many software applications. Now, we will show you how to control the texture of the fabric by adjusting the physical properties of the fabric. ## Physical Properties of Fabric First, in Marvelous Designer, you can choose the physical properties of the fabric. The first word in the name of the physical property represents the composition of the material. For example, cotton is cotton, denim is denim, wool is wool, etc. When you use different fabrics, the texture of the clothing will change. For example, leather will be harder, and silk will be softer compared to cotton. ### Fabric Composition The second word in the name of the physical property also represents the composition of the fabric. You can also use denim lightweight for your clothes. Knit-bonded jersey can be used for thick, soft pleated shirts, while polyester taffeta can be used to cover the outer layer of your clothes. These are some of the fabrics that you will often use in the process of making clothes. ## Modeling with Default Fabrics When modeling, you can first use the default fabric to make clothes and then change the fabric as needed. In addition to the preset fabric properties, we can also adjust the details and physical properties of the fabric at the bottom. ### Understanding Fabric Properties The physical properties of the fabric are divided into gold, tail, and corner lines. You can use 2D window panels and the 2D tool to check the direction of the fabric sand line. - The arrow direction indicates the gold of the fabric. - The vertical direction indicates the tail of the fabric. - The diagonal direction represents the diagonal line. First, understand the strength of gold sand and the strength of the diagonal line. The strength of gold sand will mainly affect the stretching performance of the fabric, while the strength of the diagonal line impacts the stretching performance of the diagonal line. ## Stretching Performance and Intensity When the intensity is increased, the fabric will stretch more easily, making it easier to create creases. Conversely, if the intensity is reduced, the fabric will stretch less easily, making the clothing longer, and it becomes challenging to maintain the creases that have already been created. - The higher the bending intensity, the thicker the fabric looks, and the puffier the sewing position appears, resembling the texture of leather. - The lower the bending intensity, the softer the fabric looks, closer to the texture of silk. ### Bending Intensity and Deformation The bending intensity represents the degree to which the fabric is deformed. A lower bending intensity makes it harder to deform, thus maintaining creases more easily. In contrast, a higher bending intensity makes it more challenging to maintain creases. When the bending intensity is changed to 100, the creases in the sewing would disappear. In fact, the fabric will definitely shrink after forming creases. When the fabric is bent, the creases are reduced according to how much they can deform, or the bending intensity is reduced to the degree to which the creases are not maintained. The lower the bending intensity, the faster the creases are reduced. ## Conclusion You can control the overall effect of a fabric by using these attributes. This is a sample of the fabric made from a soft material. Understanding these properties allows for better manipulation of textures and effects in your designs. ```
